title: On Revising the whole book in a year
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：revise　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 revise 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the writer ① revised the whole book in a year in silence, and every reader in the study said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the writer ② revises the whole book in a year twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ revise the whole book in a year at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ revised the whole book in a year before — a line in the manuscript for January 1952 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Revising the whole book in a year in silence, the writer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the page at the far shelf, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ revise the lessons before the examination twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Revise the lessons before the examination at once and never mention it again.

By 1965 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manuscript, and a new reader from the next study ⑧ revises the lessons before the examination in silence every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shelf, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ revised the whole book in a year again when nobody else would.

⑩ To revise the whole book in a year, my mother said in 1970, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the study remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the study forgets, somebody revises the whole book in a year twice over again and somebody must revise the whole book in a year in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 修订（一般过去式 revised the whole book in a year：1958 年写作者头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 修订（一般现在 revises the whole book in a year：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 修订（不定式 to revise the whole book in a year：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 修订（过去完成时 had revised the whole book in a year：1952 年一月的手稿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 修订（动名词 revising the whole book in a year 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 复习（revise the lessons before the examination：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去复习考前把功课复习一遍）
G. v. 复习（revise the lessons before the examination：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 修订（后段两处：新来的读者照例 revises the lessons before the examination，而母亲又一次 revised the whole book in a year）

answers.why: revise 意为“修订”，1958 年写作者一言不发地修订一年里把整本书修订一遍，那是书斋里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 revised。
revise 意为“修订”，自那以后写作者来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 revises。
revise 意为“修订”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯修订一年里把整本书修订一遍”，此处为不定式 to revise the whole book in a year。
revise 意为“修订”，手稿里 一月 那行字说明早在 1965 年之前就有人修订过，故用过去完成时 had revised。
revise 意为“修订”，写作者说“修订一年里把整本书修订一遍这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 revising the whole book in a year 作主语。
revise 意为“复习”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去复习考前把功课复习一遍”，should ever 之后用原形 revise the lessons before the examination。
revise 意为“复习”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻复习考前把功课复习一遍（revise the lessons before the examination at once），以后再也不要提起。
revise 意为“修订”，新来的读者每个月份都照例复习考前把功课复习一遍，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 revises。
revise 意为“修订”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地修订一年里把整本书修订一遍，用一般过去式 revised 叙述。
revise 意为“修订”，结尾那句是母亲 1970 年的话：要修订一年里把整本书修订一遍，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和书斋记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，写作者一言不发地修订一年里把整本书修订一遍；书斋里每一个读者都说这是头一回。（revised the whole book in a year）
多年以后，写作者仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（revises the whole book in a year）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯修订一年里把整本书修订一遍这件事本身。（to revise the whole book in a year）
早在 1952 年就有人修订一年里把整本书修订一遍，一月那天手稿上的一行字就是证据。（had revised the whole book in a year）
写作者说过，一言不发地修订一年里把整本书修订一遍这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（revising the whole book in a year 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻复习考前把功课复习一遍，以后再也不要提起。（revise the lessons before the examination，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 revise 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the writer revised the whole book in a year in silence, and nobody in the study forgot it.
Even now the writer revises the whole book in a year twice over whenever the study asks.
Revising the whole book in a year in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever revise the lessons before the examination twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new reader from the next study revises the lessons before the examination in silence every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother revised the whole book in a year again, and the study remembered that half.
